children: Hyderabad: Rapido's newly launched food delivery business Ownly is seeing an average order value (AOV) of around 250 compared 400-420 at listed rivals Swiggy and Zomato, yet cofounder Aravind Sanka believes it can build a profitable business model around smaller-ticket orders.

Sanka said 85-90% of the cost of running the food-delivery business for existing aggregators is delivery, making logistics the biggest cost for the industry. Ownly is leveraging Rapido's existing technology, teams and logistics network rather than building these capabilities separately to keep costs low. The company is also betting that lower prices can bring new consumers into online food delivery.

According to Sanka, 15% of Ownly's new orders in Bengaluru come from users who had never ordered food online before. The mobility startup, backed by Prosus and WestBridge Capital, on Friday launched Ownly in Hyderabad, its second market after Bengaluru. Ownly has on-boarded 10,000 restaurants in Hyderabad, which it plans to scale up to 30,000.
By the next quarter, Ownly plans to expand across all major metros and tier-1 cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad and Surat.

title: Rapido's Ownly Bets on Lower-Cost Food Delivery Model
